author: integrated_case_peer
genre: Research design instruction; elementary Gaussian benchmark and union bound derived in full, not a new graduate-theory chapter. Two complete worked artifacts/eight full solutions.

coverage_review.power: Prospective meaningful effect/units, two tails, known-variance exact law versus estimated-variance actual inference, variance/effect/take-up sensitivities, integer thresholds and feasibility decision. Marginal versus joint power and no posthoc-zero inference explicit.
coverage_review.assignment: Frozen roster, bank-level fixed-size uniform assignment, audit records, independent units, non-takers and no rerandomization; spillover/common-owner gate.
coverage_review.analysis_plan: Complete original candidate PAP: target,eligibility,authority,draw,outcome definitions,point estimates,variance formula,two-sided approximate tests/intervals,zeroSE contingency,roles,outputs and access.
coverage_review.preregistration: Actual timestamp/knowledge state versus merely before analysis; plan versus registration; original and amended versions retained; no actual entry or approval claimed.
coverage_review.multiple_outcomes: Declared two-test confirmatory family, exact Bonferroni argument for any true-null subset and arbitrary dependence, raw/adjusted values/boundary convention, no unusedalpha transfer, exploratory distinction and jointpower limits.
coverage_review.contingencies: Source-error correction/duplicate record/outlier handling, fixed roster/non-takers, unresolvedmissingness nonexecution, data lock beforeunblinding, safety versus efficacy stop, interference review and outcome-informed amendments.

full_reading.case1: Read complete model/domain/two-tail derivation and all scenario/table/threshold calculations; exact benchmark does not claim known real variances or exact power of the implemented approximate procedure. Constant-effect/exclusion take-up story explicitly additional and hypothetical. Final root clarity request: explicit fixedsigma2 assumption under changed receipt added before final freeze.
full_reading.case2: Read every PAP row, complete-data versus missing-data branches, p-value decision and full amendment note; no hidden outcome substitution or reallocation. Fixed-roster target preserved when confirmation cannot run. Independent source-derived registry scope kept narrow.
full_reading.exercises: All8prompts and fullsolutions read: secondoutcome/jointbound, integerthreshold, variancefeasibility, Bonferroni boundary/dependence, take-up/ITT, efficacy/safety/unitcorrection, missingness/knowledgeamendment, complete corrected designreview.
full_reading.teachback_retention: Both guides answer actual prompts and preserve quantitative assumptions, original outcome, exploration, exposure/timing and measurement-failure boundaries.
full_reading.limits: Author internal review only. No actual data, intervention, registration, approval, externalhuman evaluation or rendered browser/mobile/keyboard/print verification.

numerical_method: Independent erfc CDF plus bisection inverse, not NormalDist implementation; extracts actual visible inputs/results/table and exact inline code, executes actual code under-I-B-O, compares fullstdout and independent scenarios/thresholds. Exact rational multiplicity arithmetic and nonindependent bound witness; explicit domain guards survive optimization.

result.qualitative_review: Full plan, knowledge/timing, multiplicity and contingency reading recorded separately.

canonical_promotion: Root path-only promotion from preserved working freeze; actual canonical gates recorded separately.
